description.value: Happy Veggie World (operating as Global Vegetarian Foods Corp) is a Richmond-based plant-based meat alternatives brand that has been crafting vegan faux-meat products for over 25 years, including heat-and-serve meals and drumstick and bacon analogues. The company sells directly to food-service partners and through its own retail store. Touring cyclists with vegan or vegetarian diets may find specialty plant-based proteins here, though this is not a full-range grocery outlet.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 31m; rack at 41m; rack (covered) at 86m; rack at 93m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Happy Veggie World is a plant-based meat alternatives brand (Global Vegetarian Foods Corp) with a retail store component, not a conventional supermarket, contradicting the OSM shop=supermarket tag. The website contact page lists a Head Office/Warehouse address of 13988 Cambie Rd Unit #378 — different from OSM's 8291 Ackroyd Rd Unit 120 — and a different phone number (604-278-5519 vs OSM's 604-278-6185), raising uncertainty about which address corresponds to the retail outlet. No evidence on the website addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenity.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists 8291 Ackroyd Rd Unit 120, but website contact page shows Head Office/Warehouse at 13988 Cambie Rd Unit #378, Richmond, BC V6V 2K4. Retail store location not explicitly stated on website.
Phone discrepancy: OSM has +1-604-278-6185; website contact page shows (604) 278-5519.
OSM shop=supermarket tag overstates the nature of the business; this is a specialty plant-based meat brand with a retail outlet, not a general supermarket.
